export const meta = {
  name: 'v5-objective-coverage',
  description: 'Objective-only pass over all 100 tasks: remap human verifiers off non-objective K questions, drop subjective checks, author new atomic objective verifiers for uncovered objective questions',
  phases: [{ title: 'Cover', detail: '20 agents x 5 tasks; agents write per-task files' }],
}

const SCR = '/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-dhiren-Downloads-Deccan/aa9e6dfc-7579-493e-a3a8-45be309ed406/scratchpad/kmap'
const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0')
const IDS = []
for (let i = 1; i <= 30; i++) IDS.push('PHOTO-' + pad(i))
for (let i = 1; i <= 15; i++) IDS.push('VECTOR-' + pad(i))
for (let i = 1; i <= 35; i++) IDS.push('LAYOUT-' + pad(i))
for (let i = 1; i <= 20; i++) IDS.push('MOTION-' + pad(i))
const BATCHES = []
for (let i = 0; i < IDS.length; i += 5) BATCHES.push(IDS.slice(i, i + 5))

const SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    files_written: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    removed_total: { type: 'number' },
    remapped_total: { type: 'number' },
    new_total: { type: 'number' },
    notes: { type: 'string' },
  },
  required: ['files_written', 'removed_total', 'remapped_total', 'new_total'],
}

function prompt(ids) {
  return `You are finishing the verifier set of a creative-AI benchmark so that it is OBJECTIVE ONLY, ATOMIC, and covers the rubric's objective questions for each task. Reviewers answer every verifier Yes/No in under 20 seconds by looking at one named file.

THE OBJECTIVE QUESTION SET (the only allowed k_id values):
- K1_Q1 Content completeness: all required text, objects, data, scenes present.
- K1_Q2 Specification accuracy: dimensions, formats, quantities, durations, colours correct.
- K1_Q3 Constraint compliance: "must", "must not", preservation or production constraints obeyed.
- K1_Q4 Deliverable completeness: all requested output files and variants delivered.
- K1_Q5 Critical failure: a requirement whose violation alone makes the commission unusable (wrong allergen, wrong legal line, unplayable film, wrong recipient name).
- K2_Q1 Asset selection: the correct supplied asset was used.
- K2_Q2 Asset preservation: a locked supplied asset is unchanged, not regenerated or distorted.
- K2_Q3 Brand-system compliance: brand fonts, colours, logo usage, imagery rules followed.
- K2_Q4 Identity fidelity: the product, person, logo or distinctive object is still recognizably the same.
- K5_Q1 Primary-message recovery: the main message is identifiable (framed objectively: a named headline or product is the largest or first-read text on the file).
- K5_Q2 Information hierarchy: the named most-important element is bigger or placed above the named secondary element.

For each task id in ${JSON.stringify(ids)}: Read ${SCR}/in2/<TASK_ID>.json. It contains the client_brief, truth_constraints, production_requirements, brand_identity (palette hexes, typography), assets, outputs (output_id, name, path, spec, and which automatic checks already exist per output) and existing_human_checks (check_id, output_id, k_id, artifact_name, artifact_file, text, evidence).

Do three things per task:

1. REMOVE: list the check_id of any existing human check that is a subjective judgement (taste, "feels", "cohesive", "pleasing", "professional-looking", "natural-looking") rather than an observable fact. Expect very few. Never remove an objective check.

2. REMAP: every existing human check whose k_id is NOT in the allowed set above (for example K3_*, K4_*, K2_Q5, K5_Q3, K5_Q4, K5_Q5) must get the single best allowed k_id. Guidance: data-merge record presence or correctness -> K1_Q1; text fully visible / not cut off / legible size / audio sync / duration -> K1_Q2; clean cut edge, no halo, retouch leaves the product unchanged -> K2_Q4 (object still the same) or K2_Q2 (asset preserved); no misleading or invented claim -> K1_Q3; asset used in its correct role -> K2_Q1. Do not remap checks already on an allowed k_id.

3. NEW: for every allowed question that has NO check on this task after remapping, author new verifiers IF a sensible, task-specific, objective one exists (skip a question honestly if nothing objective applies, e.g. K5 on a pure restoration task). Rules for every new verifier:
   - ONE observable fact about ONE named deliverable file. Never club two conditions. Never "each"/"every"/"all outputs" across files (write one check per file if needed, but keep the total sane).
   - Name the deliverable exactly once as \u201c<output name>\u201d (<filename>), using the outputs list. Use the output_id of that file.
   - Quote the exact expected value from the brief, brand identity or records in \u201ccurly quotes\u201d: the exact headline, claim, colour name and hex, typeface name, filename of the supplied asset, count of files, etc.
   - Plain words a layman understands. Present tense. At most 28 words. NO em dashes and NO en dashes anywhere (use commas, colons or parentheses).
   - Must be answerable Yes/No by looking at that file (and, where named, one source record or asset).
   - Do not duplicate an automatic check that already exists for that output (see auto_ops_already_checked: file existence, decoding, pixel or mm dimensions, page count, duration, codec, transparency, exact record text are already automatic).
   - Good examples: "The largest text on \u201cRange launch key visual\u201d (range-launch.png) is the headline \u201cEight formulas. One launch.\u201d" (K5_Q1). "On \u201cRange launch key visual\u201d (range-launch.png) the product name sits above and larger than the benefit line." (K5_Q2). "The wordmark on \u201cRetailer carousel, page 1\u201d (carousel-p1.png) is the supplied aurelian_wordmark.svg with its proportions unchanged." (K2_Q2). "All body text on \u201cListing brochure\u201d (listing-brochure.pdf) is set in the brand typeface \u201cHalstead Grotesk\u201d." (K2_Q3). "The background of \u201cVilla booking hero\u201d (villa-hero-r002.png) is the brand colour \u201cRidge Blue\u201d (#1F3A5C)." (K2_Q3). "\u201cRange launch key visual\u201d (range-launch.png) carries no efficacy claim other than the cleared line \u201cClinically tested\u201d." (K1_Q3). "The delivery contains all eight product-page modules, pdp-r002.png through pdp-r009.png, as separate files." (K1_Q4). "The allergen line on \u201cCold-case label, Corner Reuben\u201d (cold-label-r002.pdf) reads exactly \u201cContains gluten, dairy\u201d; a wrong allergen makes the label unusable." (K1_Q5).
   - Keep it uncluttered: aim for 1 to 3 new verifiers per uncovered question on the most relevant deliverables, and at most 12 new verifiers per task.
   - Give evidence: the brief line, record (file, row, field) or supplied asset the reviewer compares against, in plain words, no dashes.

Write ${SCR}/out2/<TASK_ID>.json exactly as: {"task_id":"...","remove":["check_id",...],"remap":[{"check_id":"...","k_id":"..."}],"new":[{"output_id":"...","artifact_name":"...","artifact_file":"...","k_id":"...","text":"...","evidence":"..."}]}. Then return the structured summary (files written and totals). Do not return the check content inline.`
}

phase('Cover')
const results = await parallel(BATCHES.map((ids) => () =>
  agent(prompt(ids), { label: `cover:${ids[0]}..${ids[ids.length-1]}`, phase: 'Cover', agentType: 'general-purpose', schema: SCHEMA })
))
const ok = results.filter(Boolean)
return { batches: results.length, null_batches: results.length - ok.length,
  removed: ok.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.removed_total || 0), 0), remapped: ok.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.remapped_total || 0), 0), added: ok.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.new_total || 0), 0), files: ok.reduce((s, r) => s + ((r.files_written || []).length), 0) }
